task_criteria:
QA re-verification only — no implementation. This task grades the read-only QA evidence committed by tick code-factory-docs-qa-2026-11-04-09-53-51.

Criterion 1: the commit contains an appended `task_verified` event for task CF-195 whose detail is machine-parseable and names the published tip it measured plus the literal value `stale_pins=5`.
Criterion 2: tests/selftest.sh prints `SELFTEST: PASS` in the same tree and `bash scripts/boardctl validate` prints `RESULT: OK`.

Criterion 4: the committed event does not claim any row was closed, reopened or re-filed: CF-195 must still read `pending` at the graded commit.
